sitrep.defcon: DEFCON 2 — ACTIVE ALIEN INCURSION IN PROGRESS
summaryParagraphs: As of 3/16/2030 12:00:00 PM, Humanity First maintains rank #1 among 8 visible factions with a Strategic Power Index of 40/100. Its network commands 55 control points across 29 nations, representing $20.2T in terrestrial GDP and 1101 monthly scientific output. The strongest visible rival is the Aliens (Power Index: 15/100). Current reserves: Money 47294, Influence 110, Operations 18, Boost 493.9, Water 1261, Volatiles 2379, Metals 3353, Noble Metals 223, Fissiles 34, Exotics 0.

PRIORITY THEATER ALERT: the Servants control is visible in Japan ($5.60T GDP, 4/4 CPs). Visible indicators: Superpower Economy ($5.6T GDP); the Servants Executive Control (National Priority Target); Significant Boost Launch Capacity (4.3/mo).

ALIEN INCURSION ADVISORY: 1 visible alien councilor; active xenoforming is visible in 32 regions (highest activity: Salta at level 43.0); 0 visible alien facilities. Direct alien-councilor detection: ONLINE.

SPACE POSTURE: Humanity First has 14 visible orbital installations and 4 visible fleet groups. Fleet combat power is UNAVAILABLE; Water 16.4/day, Volatiles 12.4/day, Metals 12.2/day, NobleMetals 2.0/day, Fissiles 1.5/day.

geopolitical.title: Authorize Operation 'Severance' in Japan
geopolitical.statement: Japan ($5.60T GDP) holds 4 the Servants control points, including Executive authority. Stability data is unavailable.
geopolitical.action: Deploy a suitable Humanity First operative to investigate the holding and execute a visible crackdown or purge only when the current target data supports it.

geopolitical.title: Containment Sweep in Brazil
geopolitical.statement: the Servants maintain 2 control points in Brazil ($4.12T GDP).
geopolitical.action: Deploy a high-Persuasion Humanity First councilor on a visible Public Campaign mission if the current intelligence picture confirms the opportunity.

geopolitical.title: Protect Humanity First Core Holdings
geopolitical.statement: Unprotected control points in high-GDP nations remain susceptible to rival operations, including the Servants activity where visible.
geopolitical.action: Verify all confirmed executive and major-economy control points have active "Defend Interests" wards in place.

council.title: Leverage Master Operative 'Penelope Mateos' (Total Skills: 40)
council.statement: Penelope Mateos (Spy) possesses our highest operational skill rating with 2 assigned organizations.
council.action: Assign to spearhead critical superpower acquisition or council turn operations.

space.title: Review Off-World Mining Grid (14 Habs Visible)
space.statement: Humanity First's visible mining sites report Water 16.4/day, Volatiles 12.4/day, Metals 12.2/day, NobleMetals 2.0/day, Fissiles 1.5/day.
space.action: Prioritize construction or expansion at confirmed high-yield sites after comparing current resource reserves.

space.action: Maintain a defensive patrol in a relevant inner-system orbit and assign intercept orders when a confirmed threat is identified.
